import os
import subprocess
import sys

from sase.vcs_provider import get_vcs_provider

checkout_target = {{ setup.checkout_target | tojson }}
project_name = {{ setup.project_name | tojson }}
gh_ref = {{ gh_ref | tojson }}

provider = get_vcs_provider(os.getcwd())

# Checkout the PR branch so that subsequent diffs are relative to the
# PR tip rather than the default branch. Try checkout_target first
# (works for default-branch refs like origin/main), then fall back to
# Patch name -> branch name conversion.
is_patch = checkout_target == f"origin/{gh_ref}"
ok, err = provider.checkout(checkout_target, os.getcwd())
if not ok:
    if is_patch:
        # Patch ref — resolve name to branch name
        resolved = provider.resolve_revision(
            gh_ref, project_name, os.getcwd()
        )
        ok, err = provider.checkout(resolved, os.getcwd())
    else:
        # Project/repo ref — try common default branch names
        for fallback in ["master", "main"]:
            ok, err = provider.checkout(fallback, os.getcwd())
            if ok:
                break
    if not ok:
        print(
            f"Warning: checkout failed: {err}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

# Sync with remote after checkout
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "--rebase", "--quiet"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)

# Record HEAD for the diff step
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)
head = result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""
print(f"head_before={head}")
print("success=true")

head_before="{{ checkout.head_before }}"
if [ -z "$head_before" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
head_now=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
diff_dir="${SASE_TMPDIR:-${SASE_HOME:-$HOME/.sase}/tmp}/gh-diffs"
mkdir -p "$diff_dir"
diff_file=$(mktemp "$diff_dir/sase-gh-XXXXXX.diff")
if [ "$head_now" != "$head_before" ]; then
  # Commits were made — show only the last commit's diff
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)
  echo "meta_commit_message=$commit_msg"
else
  # No commits — show uncommitted changes
  git diff HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        git diff --no-index /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null
      done >> "$diff_file"
fi
if [ -s "$diff_file" ]; then
  echo "diff_path=$diff_file"
else
  rm -f "$diff_file"
fi

# Stash any uncommitted changes (including untracked files)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then
  git stash push --include-untracked -m "gh-workflow-$(date +%s)" --quiet
  echo "stashed=true"
else
  echo "stashed=false"
fi
git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 || true
git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
echo "success=true"

from sase_github.scripts.gh_setup import main
main(
    gh_ref={{ gh_ref | tojson }},
    n={{ n | tojson }},
    release={{ release | tojson }},
    workflow_label={{ workflow_label | tojson }},
)

I found the cause and staged a fix plan for your review. Nothing has been changed yet.

**Cause:** in the bob-plugins repo, `intentionSelect()` in `plugins/bob-ledger-tools/src/297c-plugin-intention-card-editor.js` writes the selected row's label into the status line. The status line only shows the keymap list when it has nothing else to show, so after a move it shows the label instead. That's why the footer turned into "Intention 2", "Reflection", and so on in your screencast. Arrows, Tab, the 1–9 keys and clicking a row go through the same function, so they hide the footer too. I reproduced it in the plugin's test harness: the footer shows the full keymap list when the panel opens, "Intention 2" after `j`, and "Intention 1" after `k`.

**Plan** (`sase_plan_intention_editor_footer_keeps_keys.md`, a small single-agent plan):
- **Fix:** selecting a row clears the status message instead of writing the label into it. The highlighted row already shows where you are, so the label adds nothing. All selection moves will keep the keymap footer. A message like "✓ Saved · u undo" stays until your next move, then the keymaps come back. Error and read-only messages are unchanged.
- **Tests:** add tests showing the footer stays through each kind of move, and that it comes back after a save or undo message.
- **Wrap-up:** add one sentence about the footer to `docs/intention-card.md`, bump the plugin's patch version, rebuild, run the tests and docs check, then `bob plugins sync`.

**One decision for you:** pressing `s` (select Summary) currently replaces the footer with "Summary selected · Enter explains ownership…". By default the plan keeps that message, and your next `j`/`k` brings the keymaps back. If you pick `footer` instead, `s` keeps the keymap footer like every other move.
